title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：robot　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 robot 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the engineer ① built the robot that no worker in the workshop would have recorded, and he said the building was the whole of the year. The ② robot, meaning the machine itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; a robot, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ robot in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ robot at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A robot, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the engineer said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the robot was the whole of the matter, meaning the skill and not the machine. The ⑥ robot, meaning the skill and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; robot, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a machine and a skill. He said the skill is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ robot had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ robot of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of recording; robot, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ robot I remember is the machine recorded in the manual, which closed in 1993 and is still recorded as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ robot, my mother said in 1995, is the only machine that improves by being recorded; every robot, she said, is a skill that has agreed to look like a machine. She said the skill was the honest half.

options: A. n. 机器人（指车间里每一台旁边的那一台）

answers.why: build the robot 意为“造这一台机器人”，1986 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯记载的一台机器人做了一遍。
robot 意为“机器人”，指那台机器人本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
robot 意为“机器人”，指车间里每一台旁边的那一台，每一台旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
robot 意为“机器人”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
robot 意为“机器人、巧技”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这台巧技就是那件事的全部。
robot 意为“巧技”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那台机器人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
robot 意为“机器人”，指说明书里写到、被记载的那一台，到 1991 年这一台成了说明书里的一行。
robot 意为“机器人之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的机器人之事是一处车间和三个年头的记载。
robot 意为“机器人”，我记得的是说明书里记载过的那一台，1993 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一台。
robot 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，机器人是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的机器人。
